data.description: True prognostication functions as divination except that the spell can see up to 100 years into the future. Because of the extreme unpredictability of the far-distant future, true prognostication is incredibly cryptic when used to learn about events on such large a scale. Material component; rare incense and tonics worth 1,000 gp.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
